title: Relabeling work symbols in an action
statement: Given an alphabet bijection $e$ and a one-step action, define its relabeled action by applying $e$ to every symbol it may write on a work tape, leaving blanks unchanged and preserving all head movements, the input-head movement, the output symbol, and the successor state.
hypotheses_covered: A one-step action for a machine with $k$ work tapes
